title: Perch and oz-policy-builder, side by side.
caption: Twelve of the twenty dimensions; every cell is read from source at Perch {{fact:perch-pin-short}}, oz-policy-builder {{fact:opb-pin-short}} and OpenZeppelin `stellar-contracts` {{fact:oz-v080-tag}}, and nothing is measured. Sources for each cell are in the full comparison table.
rows: Where the decision runs
Inside the account: the linked evaluator decides
In attached policy contracts, called by the account after authentication
Order of checks
Decide (caps included), then authenticate
Select and check expiry, authenticate, then run each policy in contract-address order

The account only

A predicate language with and/or, comparisons, quantifiers, arithmetic, time and reads
